STEP

CHECK TO BE PERFORMED REMEDIAL ACTION

IF THE CHECK IS NOT OK

1

Check on +30 power supply

Connect a voltmeter between pin 3 of connector A of the gearbox control unit and earth

Check that the battery voltage is 12V

Check the continuity of the 15 A fuse F18 located in the engine compartment junction unit

See E7051 ROBOTIZED GEARBOX

Move on to Step 2

Replace fuse F18 after identifying what caused it to blow. Restore the wiring between the junction unit and the gearbox control unit

2

+15 ignition supply check

Press the START/STOP button. Connect a voltmeter between pin 10 of connector A of the gearbox control unit and earth. Check that the battery voltage is 12V. Check the continuity of the 7.5 A fuse F24 located in the engine compartment junction unit

See E7051 ROBOTIZED GEARBOX

Move on to Step 3

Replace the fuse F24 after having identified what caused it to blow

Restore the wiring between the junction unit and the gearbox control unit

3

Earth points connection check

Disconnect the negative battery lead

Disconnect hydraulic unit control unit (C)

Check earth strips (M) are properly connected to the electrohydraulic unit control unit (as shown in the figure). Check that the earth strips are not deformed/damaged.

Check that the gearbox control unit is correctly earthed via the above points on the hydraulic unit and that the gearbox control unit connections are not damaged

Restore the earth strips, if necessary replace electrohydraulic unit

Replace the gearbox control unit
